lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Namaskara sir, Kaveri Finance inda maathadthiddini. Suresh Kumar Naik avaru maathadthiddeera?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sir, this call is being recorded. For verification, please tell me your date of birth.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you sir. Nimma personal loan alli total outstanding one lakh twenty-four thousand rupees ide. Ee account ge namma kade inda one-time settlement offer ide.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಮೊದಲು ಆ amount ಬಗ್ಗೆನೇ ನನ್ನ problem. Principal ಬರೀ ಎಂಬತ್ತು ಸಾವಿರ, ಆದ್ರೆ penal interest eighteen thousand ಹಾಕಿದ್ದೀರ, ಅದು agreement ಅಲ್ಲಿ...
lines.roman: Modalu aa amount baggene nanna problem. Principal bari embattu saavira, aadre penal interest eighteen thousand haakiddeera, adu agreement alli...

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sir sir, adu ella charges system prakaarane. Neevu settlement thagondre adu ella hogutte.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಇಲ್ಲ, ನನ್ನ ಮಾತು ಪೂರ್ತಿ ಕೇಳಿ. Agreement ಅಲ್ಲಿ penal charge ಎರಡು percent ಅಂತ ಇದೆ, ನೀವು ಅದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಜಾಸ್ತಿ ಹಾಕಿದ್ದೀರ.
lines.roman: Illa, nanna maathu poorti keli. Agreement alli penal charge eradu percent anta ide, neevu adakkintha jaasti haakiddeera.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sari sir. Settlement amount seventy-eight thousand rupees. Adanna katti account close maadkobahudu. Payment maaduva munche settlement letter written aagi kalisthivi.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Seventy-eight ಕೂಡ ಜಾಸ್ತಿ. ಮೊದಲು ಈ wrong charges ಸರಿ ಮಾಡಿ. ನನಗೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ supervisor ಜೊತೆ ಮಾತಾಡ್ಬೇಕು.
lines.roman: Seventy-eight kooda jaasti. Modalu ee wrong charges sari maadi. Nanage nimma supervisor jothe maathadbeku.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sari sir, yaava pressure illa, neevu yochane maadi decide maadi. Naanu nimma case na supervisor ge escalate maadthini.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಎಷ್ಟು ದಿನದಲ್ಲಿ call ಬರುತ್ತೆ? ಮತ್ತೆ ಈ recovery calls ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತಾ?
lines.roman: Eshtu dinadalli call barutte? Matthe ee recovery calls nillutta?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Supervisor nimage forty-eight hours olage call maadthaare sir. Recovery calls bagge naanu heloke aagalla.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಸರಿ, wait ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ. Reference ಏನಾದ್ರೂ ಇದೆಯಾ?
lines.roman: Sari, wait maadthini. Reference enaadroo ideya?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Supervisor call maadidaaga ella details heltaare sir. Thank you.

analysis.outcomeRationale: Customer disputed the penal interest, rejected the ₹78,000 offer as too high and asked for a supervisor; agent escalated with a 48-hour callback.
analysis.summary: Agent opened with a ₹78,000 one-time settlement on ₹1,24,000 outstanding, but the customer disputes ₹18,000 of penal interest as above the 2% in his agreement. Agent escalated to a supervisor with a 48-hour callback but gave no reference number and no assurance on recovery calls.
analysis.observations: Compliant and non-pressuring on the settlement, with the written letter promised up front. Weaknesses: interrupted the customer mid-dispute to push the settlement, did not explain that the loan would be reported as 'settled', and left the dispute without a ticket reference or collection pause.
analysis.improvements: Let the customer finish the dispute before pitching settlement; log the penal-charge dispute with a reference number; explain 'settled' credit-bureau reporting; and close with a recap of the escalation and what happens to recovery calls meanwhile.

op_rpc_verify.rationale: Asked for date of birth before discussing the account.

op_recording_disclosure.rationale: Stated the call is being recorded.

dp_listen_fully.rationale: Cut in with 'Sir sir' mid-explanation; customer had to ask to be heard fully.

dp_log_ticket.rationale: Customer asked for a reference; none was given.

dp_pause_collection.rationale: Said he could not comment on recovery calls.

st_explain_terms.rationale: Stated ₹78,000 but did not mention 'settled' reporting to credit bureaus.

st_written_confirmation.rationale: Promised a written settlement letter before payment.

st_no_pressure.rationale: Explicitly said 'yaava pressure illa' and let the customer decide.

cp_no_third_party.rationale: Account discussed only after DOB verification.

cl_next_step.rationale: Stated the supervisor will call the customer within 48 hours.

cl_recap.rationale: Closed with 'supervisor will tell details' — no recap of dispute, offer or escalation.
